meta.defaultDescription: Handmade gypsum figurines, toys and decorative gifts from Aparan, Armenia. Delivery across Armenia.

home.heroTitle: Gypsum figurines, shaped and painted by hand
home.heroSubtitle: Small sculptures, toys and gifts — each piece cast, finished and painted individually in our studio in Aparan.
home.featuredSubtitle: Pieces we are especially proud of right now.
home.newArrivalsSubtitle: The latest pieces from the studio.
home.categoriesSubtitle: Find the right piece for your home or as a gift.
home.storyTitle: Every piece is made by hand
home.storyP1: GIPSE is a small studio making figurines, toys and decorative objects from gypsum. Each piece is cast in a mould, cleaned, dried and painted by hand.
home.storyP2: Because everything is handmade, small differences in colour and texture are part of the charm — no two pieces are exactly alike. Many items are made to order, so please allow a little time.
home.pointHandmadeText: Cast, finished and painted by hand.
home.instagramText: New pieces, gift ideas and behind-the-scenes moments appear first on our Instagram.
home.deliveryText: We deliver across Armenia. The delivery cost is shown at checkout before you confirm your order.
home.contactText: Questions about a piece or a custom order? Write to us.
home.emptyCatalog: New pieces are on their way. Please check back soon.
